Flights from Boston to United States

Direct flights to Orlando are offered by Allegiant. This route has been announced recently, and is not operational yet. It will start in February 2027.
From Boston to Orlando there are 5 airlines that have direct services, which are American Airlines (Oneworld), Delta (SkyTeam), Frontier Airlines, JetBlue and Southwest Airlines.
The only airline with direct flights to Tampa is Allegiant. This route has been announced recently, and is not operational yet. It will start in February 2027.
All direct flights from Boston to Tampa and Traverse City are operated by American Airlines (Oneworld), Delta (SkyTeam) and JetBlue.
Non-stop flights to Washington are offered by American Airlines (Oneworld), Delta (SkyTeam) and JetBlue.
You can fly non-stop from Boston to Washington with United Airlines (Star Alliance).
